limits: Provincial causal price forecasts remain disabled: historical error checks do not validate a causal future price-to-GDP response.

Trade price experiments hold quantities fixed and are not GDP forecasts.
Existing national well coverage remains incomplete and the site remains a public beta.
deployment: Awaiting public deployment verification; see workflow history for the release result.
